content: {"trailers": [{"title": "Betrayed at the Altar", "moment_ids": ["M003", "M011", "M012"], "hook": "Gerald callously says he changed his mind, and Juliana cries out that he swore he loved her.", "cliffhanger": "The Bearded Stranger drops to one knee before Lady Juliana, offering a silver ring as she gazes down at him with tears and a trembling smile of hope.", "why": "Starts with devastating betrayal, pivots to a mysterious rescuer, and ends on a marriage proposal that leaves her fate hanging."}, {"title": "The Scarred Soldier's Secret", "moment_ids": ["M038", "M040", "M074", "M075"], "hook": "Alexander removes his shirt, revealing a torso covered in jagged battle scars, and Juliana whispers 'Dear God' in horror.", "cliffhanger": "Alexander realizes his mother is a prisoner and coldly decides to let his enemies believe he is dead a little longer.", "why": "Opens with a shocking physical reveal, deepens their bond, then exposes his hidden ducal identity and ends on a dangerous decision to stay dead."}, {"title": "Poison in the Manor", "moment_ids": ["M090", "M091", "M092"], "hook": "The Duchess chokes and spasms; Juliana rushes to prepare an antidote and tells Prudence she can try to save her.", "cliffhanger": "Juliana is trapped with an unfinished cure as the door latch turns and the door cracks open.", "why": "Begins with a life-or-death medical emergency, builds tension with approaching footsteps, and cuts on the door opening before she can finish the cure."}, {"title": "The Witch's Trial", "moment_ids": ["M124", "M161", "M164"], "hook": "Catherine swings the glowing branding iron toward Juliana's face, stopping inches from her eye as she recoils in terror.", "cliffhanger": "The cathedral doors explode in a fireball, and armed silhouettes emerge through the smoke as Juliana turns in awe.", "why": "Opens with a visceral threat of torture, escalates to public humiliation at the wedding, and ends on a fiery rescue with unknown figures emerging."}]}
